title: In Splunk Enterprise Security versions below 8.7.0, a user that holds a role with the run_collect capability could…
description: In Splunk Enterprise Security versions below 8.7.0, a vulnerability exists where a user with the run_collect capability can inject attacker-controlled values into vulnerability data. When another user accesses the Vulnerability Search dashboard and selects an affected row, the system may execute attacker-controlled Search Processing Language (SPL) commands with the permissions of the selecting user. This occurs because the dashboard encodes data-model field values for drilldown links but fails to escape them properly as SPL search literals. This flaw could allow unauthorized access to sensitive data and modification of some data accessible to the selecting user.
